coordinate_system: X increases to the right in the front view; Y points rearward; Z points upward. Rear photograph X is reversed when mapped into this frame.

sources.role: Official original hardware and published 280 mm body width
Official front/rear/top/side photograph: two right-hand front controller sockets, left headphone jack, rear EXT/AV/DC order and female EXT face
Manufacturer standard-density DE-9 2.77 mm pitch, 2.84 mm row separation and 24.99 mm mounting-axis separation; not identification of original Sega connector bodies
Adapter maker documents and tests the shared DB9 mechanical interface with original three-button Sega controllers
Working Mega-Tech-to-Mega-Drive converter designer specifies a two-row 32-position 2.54 mm edge connector in post14
Primary designer's accompanying PCB/BOM for the demonstrated cartridge converter; no circuit or game data copied
Firsthand console repair/modification provider identifies the Model1 5.5 mm OD / 2.1 mm ID coaxial power connector
Manufacturer compatible plug drawing; only radial interface used, not the modern adapter enclosure or electrical design

photo_fit.limitation: Manually identified projected landmarks. Perspective, edge selection, local heights and axial depths are not calibrated to manufacturing accuracy. One decimal place is a CAD construction choice, not a precision claim.

interface_changes.DC_socket_entry: Open annular insertion space around a recessed centre pin
interface_changes.case_joint: Estimated inner overlap lip closes the exposed case-seam sightline; side expansion opening remains clear.

estimated_clearances_and_details: DE9 female contact inner diameter 1.04 mm around retained 0.98 mm male contacts is a study clearance.
Front/rear custom housing outlines, connector depths, supports and plug overmold remain approximate.
DC socket bore 5.6 mm and centre pin 2.0 mm are study clearances for the nominal 5.5/2.1 mm plug.
Cartridge shell, PCB outline and edge-contact pad dimensions remain photographic study geometry.
Inner lip is a construction estimate: 1.2 mm wall, Z17.6 to20.3mm, with a lower supporting flange. It is not a measured molding feature.
